mentions.name: TranslateVoice
mentions.description: iPhone voice translation app where tapping the microphone uses 4o realtime to translate between two people. Has three working modes: Interpreter mode for pure two-way translation with chat history transcribed in each person's language, Friend mode where the app acts like a helpful friend to gather information toward a stated goal, and Stealth mode (still buggy) that transcribes and translates everything spoken via AirPods and suggests what to say based on an initial goal and written instructions.
mentions.problem: OpenAI's 4o app did not follow prompts well for live translation — it randomly tried to communicate with the user instead of strictly translating and cut speakers off before they finished — and existing alternatives were probably paid.
